messages:
maria_cs: quick capture from Redleaf onboarding today — dropping raw asks so product can triage. main asks: route-level spend visibility, ability to pin fallback model per-route, and show embedding index version in console.
kevin_onboarding: +1. finance and renewals both request route-level breakdowns frequently.
anya_support: they want CSV export and a daily/30d/90d view. small companies want per-route totals for chargebacks.
sam_product: ok. two workstreams: exports/metrics (short) and routing policy (long). embedding-version UI is tiny.
eva_data: export MVP: nightly rollup + CSV endpoint, estimate 1 sprint infra + 1 sprint API/UI. dashboard later.
jamie_pm: recommend priority: 1) export MVP for renewals, 2) embedding-version tag, 3) per-route fallback in routing epic.
maria_cs: customer example (redacted): "we can't explain spikes across teams without route-level spend." use in renewal slides.
triage-bot: reminder: create JIRA CS-ROUTE-2041 "Route spend export MVP".
sam_product: action items: eva drafts data spec, sam writes short brief, kevin collects 2 renewal customers to quote, jamie to add to next triage.
anya_support: I'll pull fallback-related errors for last 30d to show impact.
maria_cs: I'll update the customers after triage: promise export MVP coming, follow-up with dates. :thumbsup:
